name: Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership
summary: Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership is an Israeli company dedicated to the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas resources, notably including its operations within the Leviathan project. Founded in 1992, the firm was originally known as Ratio Oil Explorations (1992) – Limited Partnership before adopting its current name. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
